`final class AnimatedResourceDecoder`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/iresourcedecoder/), [`IResourcePlayback`](/reference/resources/iresourceplayback/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.decoder.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [AnimatedResourceDecoder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/decoder/impl/AnimatedResourceDecoder.java)

Plays an animated image, GIF, APNG, animated WebP or a format of yours, by uploading the frame of the current time.

## Description

The formats pick it with the [`IResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/iresourceanimationreader/) of the file; give it your own reader for another animated format.
The frames are decoded once, in memory, and shared by every fork of the same file; each fork has its own playback.
The time follows the JOID clock, so the animation keeps its pace whatever the frame rate.

## Property details

<a id="AnimatedResourceDecoder-property-loop"></a>

### loop

- `this loop(boolean loop)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean isLoop()` 

**Default:** 

If `true`, the animation plays forever; if `false`, once.
Without a call, the loop count stored in the file applies.

<a id="AnimatedResourceDecoder-property-autoplay"></a>

### autoplay

- `this autoplay(boolean autoplay)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `boolean isAutoplay()` 

**Default:** `true`

If `true`, the animation starts once it is uploaded.
